name: Eternal Daisy
source:
In this field of full daisies, spread across this little world, you meet a little girl with her dearest, fluffy friend, Mr. Sunny,  the gentleman or maybe gentle-lion. It seems that everything  feels peaceful here, but you believe you aren't supposed to be here.

[From [url=https://mohenk.itch.io/eternal-daisy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这片布满雏菊的田野里，在这个小世界里，你遇到了一个小女孩和她最亲爱的、毛茸茸的朋友，阳光先生，绅士或者温柔的狮子。似乎这里一切都很平静，但你认为你不应该在这里。

[来自[url=https://mohenk.itch.io/eternal-daisy]itch.io[/url]]
